name: Pi Coding Agent: A Terminal AI Coding Agent Built on 418 Lines of Code - TorchTree
description: Pi is a terminal AI coding agent with a core of just 418 lines, created by Mario Zechner, the author of libGDX. This article dissects its architecture, extension mechanism, and position in the community.
